title: Hearth of Steel
shortDescription: Anvils and hanging mail keep the room honest.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Steel is an armory that still remembers it is a classroom. Anvils sit where first-years will learn not to lean. Mail hangs in a neat row, oiled and unromantic. Practice swords wait on a rack that has been tended more often than it has been praised. The air smells of metal, leather, and a little linseed oil.
Mentor Edge keeps the floor clear and the excuses shorter than the lesson.
A straw hearth dummy stands where a lesson can be finished without guessing.

fixtures.name: Mentor Edge
fixtures.lookDescription: A scarred hare in a mail shirt, one ear notched, a practice sword at the hip. Try talk edge.
fixtures.examineDescription: Edge's notch is newer than Flint's and just as earned. The mail is mended. He treats a sloppy stance as a kindness you have not yet been given.
fixtures.dialogue: Edge has four mail shirts hanging oiled behind him and a strap in his paws. "Steel is a blade kept flat until it is wanted, and a stance you can name out loud." He tips his head at the straw dummy in the corner. "Talk edge when you are ready."

welcome.text: "Metal, leather, linseed. Mail hanging oiled and unromantic. Look around this hearth. Name the stance before you swing. Then attack the hearth dummy in here, mine and not the one Flint keeps out in his orchard, unless you are still learning the spark on his. Come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem."

craft.text: "The Field Primer is your book. I open this School's leaf and ink the stem after you look around this hearth, defeat the dummy, and talk to me. Later the Primer holds ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name. A sloppy stance is a kindness you have not yet been given."

go.text: "Look around this hearth. Defeat the dummy. I will be here by the anvil. Excuses stay shorter than the lesson."

lessons-done.text: "The stem is inked. Cast strike at the hearth dummy for the second lesson. After that, the Primer holds one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."

third-lesson.text: "Your blade is on the rack and it stays there. Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study, up from the Great Hall. If he has you on the Clock Tower stair, finish it first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."

third-done.text: "This hearth is finished with you. Each lesson off the grounds leaves one ink in the Primer, and I sign the page whether I am standing at your shoulder or not." He sets the oil rag down. "Keeper Holm kept a stair lit so first-years would not walk it in the dark. Nobody handed him a medal for it either. Eat something warm before you walk a cold road."

fixtures.name: Practice Anvil
fixtures.examineDescription: The face of the anvil is bright from use. A rack of practice blades waits, oiled and unromantic. A slate says: 'Name the stance before you swing.'
